title: Cosmic Dream Weaver
description: A surreal cosmic scene features a large translucent purple multi-eyed alien creature floating in a starry black sky, its tongue sticking out. Below, a black silhouetted astronaut with a colorful backpack walks along a winding purple path through a field of purple flowers, while a cracked blue globe spills liquid onto the black ground near a red planet with rings.
prompt: A surreal psychedelic scene in a black starry space with constellations, featuring a large translucent purple amorphous alien creature with multiple blue eyes and tentacles, sticking out a red tongue, with several black mask-like faces emerging from its body and small glass orbs hanging from it. In the foreground, a black silhouetted astronaut with a detailed backpack walks on a winding purple path through a field of purple flowers on the left, while on the right a cracked blue globe spills blue liquid and a red ringed planet sits on a green patch, all rendered in vibrant illustrative style with bold outlines.
